parameters.content:
## Category page SEO

Writes the intro and meta tags for each collection from its live products, links it to its parent, children and siblings in code, and asks you in Slack before anything changes. Sorts every collection daily so in-stock products come first, and audits internal links weekly.

### How it works
1. **Setup** (run once) creates `collection_copy` and `link_audit`. Import your keywords into `collection_copy`.
2. **Write** (every 4 hours) picks collections with no copy, or queued for a refresh, reads their products and their place in the menu, writes the copy (AI for head terms, a template for the long tail), checks it and adds links in code, then posts a card.
3. **Review** (Slack buttons) checks Slack's signature. Approve re-reads the live description and writes the copy with `collectionUpdate`; Redraft queues it again; Skip leaves it.
4. **Sort** (daily) puts relevant, buyable products first and sold-out, draft or image-less ones last. Starts as a dry run.
5. **Audit** (weekly) finds orphan collections, menu links to empty ones and children their parent doesn't link to, and queues those parents for a redraft.

### Setup
1. Credentials: Postgres with your Supabase connection string on every table node, Custom Auth with your Shopify client ID and secret on every **Get Shopify token** node, Slack API on the Slack nodes, Crypto with your Slack signing secret on **Sign the request**, Ollama on **Ollama Chat Model**.
2. Fill in each lane's settings node.
3. Run **Run once to set up** and import your keywords.
4. Point your Slack app's Interactivity URL at **Slack button click**, then publish.

### Customisation
- Swap **Ollama Chat Model** for any chat model sub-node.
- Change `voice`, `store_facts` and `examples` in **Write settings**.
- Set `dry_run` to false in **Sort settings** once the report looks right.

## Setup (run once)
Creates the two Supabase tables. Safe to run again. Then import your keyword rows into `collection_copy`: handle, keyword, other_searches, volume.

parameters.query:
create table if not exists collection_copy (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  handle text,
  title text,
  keyword text,
  other_searches text,
  volume double precision,
  gid text,
  parent_handle text,
  status text,
  intro text,
  body_html text,
  meta_title text,
  meta_description text,
  flags text,
  reviewed_by text,
  live_html text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (handle)
);

create table if not exists link_audit (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  run_date timestamptz,
  handle text,
  issue text,
  parent_handle text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);

parameters.content:
## Write (every 4 hours)
Picks collections that need copy, builds the context from their live products and menu, writes with AI or a template, checks it, adds links in code and posts a review card.

nodes.name: Write settings
nodes.notes: Your settings for the Write lane. The examples carry your voice until you have approved intros of your own.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

parameters.query: select * from collection_copy order by id

nodes.name: Write the copy
nodes.notes: Returns plain text; Check and link reads the JSON. A failed call comes out as an error item, so that collection is marked failed and the rest carry on.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat Model
nodes.notes: Ollama Cloud: an Ollama credential with Base URL https://ollama.com and your API key. Swap for any chat model.

parameters.query: insert into collection_copy (handle, title, keyword, other_searches, volume, gid, parent_handle, status, intro, body_html, meta_title, meta_description, live_html, flags) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5::text, '')::double precision, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14) on conflict (handle) do update set title = excluded.title, keyword = excluded.keyword, other_searches = excluded.other_searches, volume = excluded.volume, gid = excluded.gid, parent_handle = excluded.parent_handle, status = excluded.status, intro = excluded.intro, body_html = excluded.body_html, meta_title = excluded.meta_title, meta_description = excluded.meta_description, live_html = excluded.live_html, flags = excluded.flags, "updatedAt" = now() returning *

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ (($json.handle)) ?? null, (($json.title)) ?? null, (($json.keyword)) ?? null, (($json.other_searches)) ?? null, (($json.volume)) ?? null, (($json.gid)) ?? null, (($json.parent_handle)) ?? null, (($json.status)) ?? null, (($json.intro)) ?? null, (($json.body_html)) ?? null, (($json.meta_title)) ?? null, (($json.meta_description)) ?? null, (($json.live_html)) ?? null, (($json.flags.join('; '))) ?? null ] }}

parameters.blocksUi:
={{ JSON.stringify({ blocks: [
  { type: 'header', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Copy to review: ' + $json.title } },
  { type: 'section', text: { type: 'mrkdwn', text: '*Meta title* (' + $json.meta_title.length + ')\n' + $json.meta_title + '\n*Meta description* (' + $json.meta_description.length + ')\n' + $json.meta_description } },
  { type: 'section', text: { type: 'mrkdwn', text: '*Intro*\n' + $json.intro } },
  { type: 'context', elements: [{ type: 'mrkdwn', text: '`/collections/' + $json.handle + '` · keyword `' + $json.keyword + '` · written by ' + $('Check and link').item.json.written_by +
    ' · links: ' + ($('Check and link').item.json.links.join(', ') || 'none') + ($json.flags ? '\n:warning: ' + $json.flags : '') }] },
  { type: 'actions', elements: [
    { type: 'button', style: 'primary', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Approve' }, action_id: 'copy_approve', value: $json.handle },
    { type: 'button', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Redraft' }, action_id: 'copy_redraft', value: $json.handle },
    { type: 'button', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Skip' }, action_id: 'copy_skip', value: $json.handle } ] }
] }) }}

## Review (Slack buttons)
Checks Slack's signature and ignores old cards. Approve re-reads the live description so a hand edit is never overwritten, then writes the copy. Redraft queues it again; Skip leaves it.

### Writes to Shopify
Replaces the collection description and SEO title and description. Test on a development store first.

## Sort (daily)
Scores each collection's products against its keyword and puts sold-out, draft, image-less and unpriced products last. Reports only while `dry_run` is true.

nodes.name: Sort settings
nodes.notes: Your settings for the Sort lane. Keep dry_run on until you have read the first report.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token for Sort
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

parameters.query: select * from collection_copy order by id

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `query($id: ID!) { collection(id: $id) { sortOrder products(first: 250, sortKey: COLLECTION_DEFAULT) { nodes {
    id title status totalInventory tracksInventory featuredMedia { id } priceRangeV2 { minVariantPrice { amount } } } } } }`, variables: { id: $json.gid } }) }}

nodes.name: Reorder products
nodes.notes: Runs before the report: branches run top to bottom.

parameters.content:
### Writes to Shopify
Sets the collection to Manual sort, then moves its products on the next run. Runs only when `dry_run` is false.

## Audit (weekly)
Finds collections nothing links to, menu links to empty collections and children their parent page does not link to. Saves the findings, queues those parents for a redraft and posts a summary.

nodes.name: Audit settings
nodes.notes: Your settings for the Audit lane. theme_linked: handles your theme links in code, such as a brands page.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token for Audit
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

parameters.query: insert into link_audit (run_date, handle, issue, parent_handle) values (NULLIF($1::text, '')::timestamptz, $2, $3, $4) returning *

nodes.name: Queue a redraft
nodes.notes: Only parents whose copy you approved. A parent with no row yet is picked up by Write anyway once its description is empty.

parameters.query: update collection_copy set status = $1, "updatedAt" = now() where handle = $2 and status = $3 returning *
